### Borea v0.6.28

Update with "Update now" on the Home banner or run `borea update-self`.

[Website](https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [Content index](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index) | [Source and issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea)

#### Improved

- Borea now recognizes game build `2026.11.16.5901`.
- When the Show filter hides every release, the Versions tab names a release status you can show.
- Simplified Chinese now covers the game start options and the prompts for copying and backing up game settings. Thank you, @kuxiaowo!

#### Fixed

- Content index, update and share requests time out if a server stops sending data. The App and CLI can refresh the same content index without mixing an index file with the cache tag of another download.
- A failed file export keeps the local file it would have replaced.
- A mod or mod pack link installs into the instance shown in its confirmation, even if you switch instances while Borea looks up its releases.
- An install failure keeps files that another install put in place. Restoring your own content over an installed folder clears the replaced folder's install record. Removing a mod keeps dependencies that a manually installed mod still uses.
- Borea checks the launch file for the game platform when it installs a loader. If a loader fails to start, Borea restores the loader's previous game folder setting.
- The game update banner opens only HTTPS links on `ahwoo.com` or its subdomains. If there is no usable download link, it opens the game's page.

[Full changelog for v0.6.27 to v0.6.28](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/compare/v0.6.27...v0.6.28)
